query: multilingual pretraining, masked language modeling, akkadian language, missing text prediction
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT corpus_id, citation_count, year
FROM Papers
WHERE (
    title ILIKE '%multilingual%' OR
    abstract ILIKE '%multilingual%'
)
AND (
    title ILIKE '%pretrain%' OR
    abstract ILIKE '%pretrain%'
)
AND (
    title ILIKE '%mask% language model%' OR
    abstract ILIKE '%mask% language model%' OR
    title ILIKE '%masked LM%' OR
    abstract ILIKE '%masked LM%' OR
    title ILIKE '%MLM%' OR
    abstract ILIKE '%MLM%'
)
AND (
    title ILIKE '%Akkadian%' OR
    abstract ILIKE '%Akkadian%'
)
AND (
    title ILIKE '%missing text%' OR
    abstract ILIKE '%missing text%' OR
    title ILIKE '%text prediction%' OR
    abstract ILIKE '%text prediction%' OR
    title ILIKE '%cloze%' OR
    abstract ILIKE '%cloze%'
)
ORDER BY citation_count DESC, year DESC
LIMIT 100
